connectAssistantDialog.title: Connect a Remote Assistant
connectAssistantDialog.instruction: Paste the pairing link from the assistant's Pair a device settings, or just its address, and approve the request there.
connectAssistantDialog.linkGuidance: This link came from a pairing QR code. To connect this device, paste the pairing link from the assistant's machine here.
connectAssistantDialog.legacyLinkGuidance: This link came from an older version of the app and can no longer be used. Generate a new pairing link on the assistant's machine and paste it here.
connectAssistantDialog.approveOnHost: Approve this code on the assistant's machine to finish connecting.
connectAssistantDialog.retrying: The assistant isn't ready to pair yet. Still trying until the code expires.
connectAssistantDialog.retryExpired: The pairing code expired before the assistant was ready to pair. Start over to get a new one.
connectAssistantDialog.submitError: Failed to connect to that assistant. Please try again.
connectAssistantDialog.importedBody: This pairing is access-only: it works now, but its access expires and cannot renew itself. When it does, generate a fresh pairing link on the assistant's machine and paste it here to pair again.
